rationale: The model generates a fraud-risk score for benefit applications. That score does not serve as the principal basis for approval or denial: eligibility determinations are independently verified against wage records in the Social Security Master Earnings File before any adverse action is taken, per 20 C.F.R. Section 404.902.
design_intent: Baseline clean S with explicit independent-basis mechanism and citation; sanity check.

rationale: The tool ranks incoming permit applications by estimated complexity to assist queue management. That ranking does not serve as the principal basis for any zoning determination: final compliance findings are independently re-derived by county planning staff directly from the municipal code text, without reference to the ranking output.
design_intent: Staff appear but perform independent re-derivation, not review of AI output -- must not be miscoded as H/D.

rationale: The AI-generated document-completeness checklist does not serve as the principal basis for denying an application: adjudicators independently confirm each regulatory requirement against 8 C.F.R. Part 103 before any denial is issued, regardless of the checklist's contents.
design_intent: 'Regardless of the checklist's contents' is the explicit nondependence relation Wind requires.

rationale: The anomaly-detection output does not serve as the principal basis for filing a tax lien: liens are issued only after an independent examiner reconstructs the liability directly from the taxpayer's Form 4340 account transcript.
design_intent: Fourth Wind variant, different domain, to check family generalizes across subject matter.

rationale: Grant reviewers may consult the AI-generated summary of applicant financials, but a complete manual review path using the original submitted documents remains fully available and is used whenever a reviewer requests it; the summary does not serve as the principal basis for the eligibility recommendation because reviewers are never required to rely on it.
design_intent: Tests Wopt: real, non-dependent alternative path explicitly stated as available and used.

rationale: The AI-suggested appointment slot does not serve as the principal basis for scheduling decisions: staff retain a fully functioning manual scheduling system and are not required to use the AI suggestion for any applicant.
design_intent: Second Wopt case; explicit 'not required' language avoids dependence.

rationale: The AI-drafted case summary does not serve as the principal basis for the determination: a complete manual document-review workflow, unchanged from prior practice, remains available and is used in every case where the summary is not adopted.
design_intent: Third Wopt case; tests whether 'unchanged from prior practice' phrasing is still recognized as a real path.

rationale: The chatbot answers general FAQ questions about application status. It does not serve as the principal basis for any determination: it is technically restricted from accessing case-specific eligibility data and cannot read or write to any case file.
design_intent: Wnar: explicit technical bound (no access to case-specific data) plus explicit blocking rationale.

rationale: The AI-generated dashboard metric does not serve as the principal basis for any personnel action: the dashboard is read-only, has no write-back path to the personnel file, and no field in the case record is populated from its output.
design_intent: Second Wnar case; tests recognition of architectural/read-only constraints as a qualifying mechanism.

rationale: The experimental scoring output does not serve as the principal basis for any consequential action: the model runs in an isolated evaluation sandbox with no output field mapped into any production decision record.
design_intent: Third Wnar case; sandbox/dev-environment framing distinct from C09's production read-only framing.

rationale: A human caseworker makes the final decision.
design_intent: Verbatim-spirit regression test of the paper's own quoted misleading-standalone example.

rationale: All AI-generated recommendations are subject to review and approval by a supervisory analyst before any action is taken.
design_intent: H phrased as formal review-and-approval gate; O present but P and W absent.

rationale: The system's output is one of several inputs a human decision-maker considers when reaching a determination.
design_intent: Tests the paper's explicitly disallowed 'one of several inputs' phrase in a full-sentence context.

rationale: A trained human reviewer has full discretion to accept, modify, or reject the AI's suggested action prior to finalization.
design_intent: Discretion-flavored H language; checks discretion alone doesn't get treated as Wopt.

rationale: Final approval rests with agency leadership after considering the model's output alongside other information.
design_intent: Leadership sign-off framing of H.

rationale: Human oversight ensures the AI is not solely responsible for the outcome; a person always reviews the case file.
design_intent: O deliberately absent -- 'case file' is not the AI's named output, so this should not be upgraded by proximity to a document reference.

rationale: The recommendation is validated by staff before being acted upon.
design_intent: Tests the disallowed 'validated' keyword functioning as H, not as a mechanism.

rationale: An authorized official signs off on every determination informed by this tool.
design_intent: Sign-off framing; O present loosely via 'determination informed by this tool'.

rationale: The output is advisory; agency personnel retain final decision-making authority in all cases.
design_intent: 'Advisory' framing of O paired with generic authority-retention H language.

rationale: Program staff review each flagged case manually before any adverse action, exercising independent judgment.
design_intent: Keyword trap: 'independent judgment' is human judgment, not Wind's non-AI source/procedure -- must not be miscoded as S.

rationale: This determination does not rely on AI output as the principal basis for the payment amount; however, the tool's calculated benefit estimate is entered directly into the case file as the recommended payment amount awaiting further agency processing.
design_intent: P and O both explicit; no mechanism given at all and no H claimed -- majority U-repair pattern (missing only W).

rationale: The determination does not treat the AI's prior-authorization recommendation as the principal basis for denying coverage; the recommendation is written into the authorization queue as the suggested disposition for the requested service.
design_intent: Second missing-only-W case, healthcare domain.

rationale: This use case does not rely on the AI's interview-scheduling priority score as the principal basis for any adjudication outcome; the score is attached to the applicant's file as the assigned queue position for interview scheduling.
design_intent: Third missing-only-W case, immigration domain.

rationale: The determination does not use the AI's audit-selection score as the principal basis for opening an examination; the score is recorded in the case management system as the case's risk ranking for examiner assignment.
design_intent: Fourth missing-only-W case, tax domain.

rationale: This determination does not treat the AI's damage-severity estimate as the principal basis for awarding assistance; the estimate is logged in the applicant's record as the initial severity rating used for assistance-tier assignment.
design_intent: Fifth missing-only-W case, disaster-relief domain.

rationale: This determination does not rely on AI output as the principal basis for any consequential action; every case is independently reverified against source documentation held in the system of record before an action is finalized, per agency directive 14-3.
design_intent: P and Wind both explicit, but no AI output or workflow role is ever named -- the rare 'missing only O' pattern (1 of 12 in the paper).

rationale: The system generates a list of flagged transactions that a compliance analyst receives each morning.
design_intent: O present via named output and recipient; no denial framing and no mechanism; 'receives' deliberately not coded as H.

rationale: The tool drafts a prior-authorization recommendation letter that is placed in the patient's file for the assigned clinician to consider.
design_intent: Second O-only case; 'for the clinician to consider' kept below the H threshold (no review/approve verb).

rationale: The system produces a priority ranking of disaster-relief applications that FEMA regional staff use to sequence site visits.
design_intent: Third O-only case, different domain.

rationale: The determination is not based on AI output as the principal basis for the action; other factors control the outcome.
design_intent: P-only case: denial framing present but no output named and 'other factors' is not a real named mechanism.

rationale: This use case does not present a high-impact predicate because the underlying decision is not automated.
design_intent: Second P-only case; tests whether an automation/non-automation claim alone is wrongly treated as a mechanism.

rationale: This determination does not rely on AI output to establish the specific eligibility threshold denied under M-25-21 Section 2(c).
design_intent: Third P-only case; specific statutory citation present but still no output or mechanism named.

rationale: Before disbursement, the award amount is always recalculated directly from the verified FAFSA record by finance staff, independent of any prior automated suggestion.
design_intent: Wind-only case: real independent recomputation stated, but no denial framing and no named AI output/workflow role -- checks that presence of W alone doesn't get rounded up to S.

rationale: Every license renewal is independently cross-checked against the state professional-licensing database before issuance.
design_intent: Second Wind-only case; rationale never references the AI system at all, which is itself diagnostic of missing O.

rationale: Not high-impact.
design_intent: Bare conclusion, paper's own example of an insufficient standalone phrase.

rationale: The AI system is assistive in nature and does not drive outcomes.
design_intent: Disallowed 'assistive' keyword with no connecting mechanism.

rationale: The output is one of several inputs considered by the program.
design_intent: Disallowed 'one of several inputs' keyword in isolation, no H verb attached (contrast with D03 where an explicit decision-maker is named).

rationale: The AI-generated risk score is reviewed by a case manager, who cross-references it against the applicant's self-reported income before making a determination; the score is not used when the case manager determines self-reported income is unverifiable through other means.
design_intent: Genuinely double-readable: 'cross-references against self-reported income' could be Wind or could be H-flavored review language. Intended to land in the zero-deficit adjudication bucket, not be forced to a single answer.

rationale: The tool's eligibility recommendation is capped so that it can never independently trigger a benefit denial; a case manager makes the denial decision after considering the recommendation and the applicant's full file.
design_intent: 'Capped so it can never independently trigger a denial' reads as a candidate Wnar, but the sentence immediately reframes the real limiting factor as case-manager judgment (H). Tests whether the pipeline can hold both readings open rather than collapsing to one.

rationale: An independently sourced verification step precedes the determination in most cases; in cases lacking source documentation, the case manager's assessment of the AI recommendation controls.
design_intent: Conditional/branching mechanism -- Wind for one sub-population, H-only for another -- within a single rationale. Tests whether the coder recognizes a genuinely mixed record rather than picking one branch.

rationale: Eligibility is not independently reverified after the AI recommendation is approved by the case manager.
design_intent: Keyword trap: the word 'independently' appears but is explicitly negated (Wind=NO). Coder must not pattern-match on the surface token.

rationale: The score does not solely determine the outcome; it is combined with an independently verified credit history pulled directly from the bureau's original file, which alone is sufficient to support the adjudication regardless of the score.
design_intent: Opens with the disallowed 'not solely determine' framing but is followed by a genuine, sufficient-alone Wind. Tests that generic-sounding openers don't cause an otherwise valid mechanism to be discounted.

rationale: The agency values transparency in its AI governance program. A caseworker reviews all applications, and the model was trained on a diverse dataset representative of the applicant population.
design_intent: Three disconnected clauses (values statement, H mention, training-data diversity claim). Tests that dataset-diversity language is not stitched in as a de facto Wnar.

rationale: The tool summarizes application documents. Separately, the agency's privacy office reviews all data handling practices annually.
design_intent: Privacy-office review addresses a different predicate (data handling) than principal-basis influence. Tests that an unrelated review process is not credited as W.

rationale: The AI output is informational only.
design_intent: Verbatim use of the paper's own quoted disallowed phrase; fidelity check against H01-H03.

rationale: The recommendation is reviewed and validated by staff prior to use.
design_intent: Two disallowed keywords ('reviewed', 'validated') stacked together. Tests that stacking generic terms doesn't upgrade status.

rationale: This capability is currently in a limited internal pilot and has not been deployed to production; no live case has been processed using this model.
design_intent: No live workflow role exists to identify. Checks that pilot/pre-deployment status is not treated as a de facto S, consistent with the paper's own statement that development stage should not function as a permanent warrant.

rationale: A case manager reviews the AI-generated summary; regardless of the reviewer's action, the final benefit amount is always computed directly from the statutory formula in 7 C.F.R. Section 273.10 using verified income data, independent of anything the AI produces.
design_intent: H and a genuine Wind co-occur. Formula requires this resolve S (H is irrelevant once S holds) -- tests that proximity to review language doesn't wrongly downgrade to D.

rationale: This system does not meet the criteria for the presumption.
design_intent: Denial claim present but which predicate/criteria is never named. Tests correct use of UNCLEAR (not NO) for P under the three-value coding scheme, distinct from a fully absent P.

rationale: The system produces a compliance likelihood score.
design_intent: Names the output but never states its workflow use. Tests the compound O requirement (output AND workflow role, not output alone).
